authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner carváti/cárvayati explicitly lists Oriya cābibā bite and neighbouring Bhojpuri/Hindi cab-/cāb- chew/bite. These survey forms preserve that stem with ordinary finite or infinitive endings; the eastern s-/j- and Bagheli e-vowel spellings are qualified regional comparisons. Forms with an independent take/give auxiliary are excluded.
